```plato
    // The plane rotated by a quaternion. A rotation is rigid and fixes the origin,
    // so only the normal moves: the origin offset Distance is unchanged, and the
    // rotated normal is still unit.
    Transform(pl: Plane, rotation: Quaternion): Plane
        => (Direction3D(pl.Normal.Vector.Transform(rotation)), pl.Distance);
```

## Line 458

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/lines.library.plato, line 458](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/lines.library.plato#L458).

```plato

    // The plane carried through an arbitrary 4x4 transform. A plane is a covector,
    // so it transforms by the INVERSE TRANSPOSE of the point transform: with this
    // library's row-vector convention (v' = v M), the coefficient row
    // (Normal, -Distance) is multiplied by Transpose(Invert(matrix)). The result's
    // normal is NOT renormalized -- a non-uniform scale leaves it non-unit, which
    // breaks Direction3D's invariant until Normalize repairs it.
    Transform(pl: Plane, matrix: Matrix4x4): Plane
    {
        var m = matrix.Invert.Transpose;
        var n = pl.Normal.Vector;
        var q = Number4(n.X, n.Y, n.Z, -pl.Distance).Transform(m);
        return (Direction3D(Vector3D(q.X, q.Y, q.Z)), -q.W);
    }
```
